description: This file contains an abstract base class for testing Roslyn diagnostic analyzers within the Orleans project. It provides infrastructure for compiling test code, running analyzers, and verifying diagnostics, facilitating automated testing of code analysis rules related to Orleans grains.

classes.name: DiagnosticAnalyzerTestBase`1
classes.description: A base class for unit testing Roslyn diagnostic analyzers for Orleans, providing methods to compile code, run analyzers, and check diagnostics.

methods.name: CreateDiagnosticAnalyzer
methods.description: Creates an instance of the diagnostic analyzer being tested. Can be overridden for custom analyzers.

methods.name: AssertNoDiagnostics
methods.description: Runs the analyzer on the provided source code and asserts that no diagnostics are produced.

methods.name: GetDiagnosticsAsync
methods.description: Compiles the source code, runs the analyzer, and returns diagnostics with the source text.

methods.name: GetDiagnosticsFullSourceAsync
methods.description: Performs full compilation and analysis, returning diagnostics ordered by source location.

methods.name: CreateProject
methods.description: Creates a Roslyn project with necessary references and source code for analysis.
